prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Chen Gong from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the strategist who once saved Cao Cao and then turned against her. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour, skin tone, costume and weapon are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: principled pride, a scholar-strategist's robe, a stern refusal.

World (fixed): the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 2) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 3) thin leaf-patterned armor plates and flowing light fabric panels with a slender circlet — a slender, graceful silhouette; 4) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 5) a floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament — a long, devout silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): a strategy scroll, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style and no Chinese fittings, silk tassels or hanzi.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): glossy jet-black hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): scarlet red, black lacquer, burnished gold and white plume accents, with small accents of deep navy blue and cold steel silver (Cao Wei).

Rank (fixed): she is a master strategist — her costume must read scholarly prestige at first glance: elegant, layered and finely ornamented, with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour and skin tone), another costume shape from the list with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; Western medieval setting and dress only — no Chinese architecture, robes, junks or hanzi; no logo or watermark.

Original design: Choose silhouette 5, an elaborate floor-length priestly vestment with gold-trimmed stoles and a tall head ornament. Jet-black hair in a sleek chin-length rounded bob with a side part; soft small oval face, warm amber eyes and a serene unyielding expression. The stoles separate into two sculpted parchment-like folded lengths at the waist, embodying a rejected imperial command through garment construction. Scarlet and black with burnished gold embroidery and white plume accents, small deep navy and cold silver details. Deep neckline, bare upper arms and high side opening, intimate areas covered. Hold a Western metal-roller magical strategy scroll in one hand, other hand poised open beside it. A ruined Western imperial library arcade, sunlit pale stone, warm rim highlights, no Chinese elements. Full-body portrait with both hands and boots in frame.

A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Chen Gong of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the strategist who once saved Cao Cao and then turned against her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: a sharp, striking, intense look; fair skin; oval face; large eyes — wide almond eyes, level outer eye corners; thin straight brows; small button nose; soft, full lips; pale violet eyes; sharp winged eyeliner.
Body and hair: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist build; very long hair tied low with long flowing ribbons with no bangs, forehead bare; glossy jet-black hair.
Expression: a level, steady look, mouth closed, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: principled pride, a scholar-strategist's robe, a stern refusal.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MEDIEVAL FANTASY
Costume: an archmage-strategist's robes — layered robes with runic embroidery, a high collar, a circlet, a staff or a grimoire, star-chart motifs. Western medieval high-fantasy dress — plate, mail and heraldic tabards, gowns and mantles, circlets and crowns; steel, leather, wool, velvet and gold, with a subtle magical glow along the patterns. Her Three Kingdoms origin shows through her signature item, her colours and her bearing.
Silhouette: a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: scarlet red, black lacquer, burnished gold and white plume accents, with small accents of deep navy blue and cold steel silver (Cao Wei).
Signature item: a strategy scroll, reimagined as a Western high-fantasy version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — polished steel and silvered mithril throughout, the shaft or hilt also forged metal with engraved runes (never plain wood), a faint magical glow running along the edge and the runes, a gem-set guard or socket, a leather-wrapped grip and heraldic or elven ornament, with any animal motif re-sculpted in Western heraldic style. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare upper arms below the pauldrons, which stay seated on top of her shoulders (bare shoulders only where no shoulder guard sits), a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, the tabard or gown cut with a high side slit at full length — it shows the side line of one leg as she stands, no leg pushed out or knee bent for it; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: the shattered realms of medieval high fantasy, an age of rival warlords after a fallen empire: a ruined imperial capital, mercenary camps, border keeps, outlaw marches and wild southern jungles, dark violet battle-magic.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — banners and shields carry only heraldic devices (a beast or a crest), never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A Western medieval setting and dress only — stone castles, Romanesque or Gothic architecture — with no Chinese architecture, robes or hanzi.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: 1024x1536, one main adult woman; natural connected arms and legs.
